user_story: As a user, I want to fill out the checkout information form so that I can proceed with my purchase. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The form must include input fields for 'First Name' with selector [data-test="firstName"], 'Last Name' with selector [data-test="lastName"], and 'Zip/Postal Code' with selector [data-test="postalCode"]. 2. The form must have a 'Continue' button with selector [data-test="continue"]. 3. If the form is submitted without any inputs, the user remains on the same page and the URL does not change. 4. If the form is filled out correctly and submitted, the user is navigated to the next step in the checkout process.
